name: Kaiki Gensou Yume Monogatari Kaijuu Kidan Ouja Den
original_name: 怪奇幻想夢物語 怪獣綺譚 桜蛇伝
source:
"I shouldn't have met you when the whole thing ends up scattering away..." 
A strange tale of ephemeral love between a human and a non-human.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229315.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“当一切都散去的时候，我就不该遇见你……” 
一个关于人类和非人类之间短暂爱情的奇怪故事。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229315.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
